_note: Pin record for the candidate substrate Multi4D (ECCV 2026). Written 2026-09-18 during Phase 0/1 of the substrate-reproduction block. Every value was read from the pinned checkout on Leonardo at $W/repo/multi4d, not from a summarizing fetch layer, except the fields explicitly marked source=github_api. Follows the template of stg-pin.json.

repository.name: BatFaceWayne/Multi4D
repository.submodules: NONE. There is no .gitmodules; submodules/diff-gaussian-rasterization, submodules/simple-knn and diff_gaussian_rasterization_hybrid/ are all vendored source trees in-tree. A --recursive clone is neither needed nor meaningful.
repository.checkout_state_at_pin: git status --porcelain returns 0 lines after the extension builds; the .gitignore covers build/ and *.egg-info/. Tracked files are pristine.

paper.title: Multi4D: High-Fidelity Dynamic Gaussian Splatting via Multi-Level Competitive Allocation
paper.authors: Rui Wang, Quentin Lohmeyer, Siyu Tang, Mirko Meboldt (ETH Zurich)

# a plain venv works too:  python3.11 -m venv multi4d && . multi4d/bin/activate
readme_n3v_verbatim.authors_verified_stack_verbatim: Verified from scratch on Python 3.11.6, torch 2.5.1+cu121, numpy 1.26.4, mmcv 1.6.0, CUDA 12.1.
readme_n3v_verbatim.jit_note_verbatim: the hybrid rasterizer is JIT-compiled on first import, so the first run takes a few extra minutes on a GPU.
readme_n3v_verbatim.neu3d_data_layout_verbatim:
<scene>/
├── poses_bounds.npy      LLFF poses, one row per camera
├── fused.ply             dense COLMAP cloud from frame 0 -- inits the static branch
├── cam00.mp4 … camNN.mp4 one video per camera
└── cam00/images/         frames, auto-extracted from the videos on first run
readme_n3v_verbatim.neu3d_data_provenance_verbatim: Prepared the [DeGauss](https://github.com/BatFaceWayne/DeGauss) way -- follow their Neu3D instructions, which produce the layout below. Train with `-s <scene>`.
readme_n3v_verbatim.train_command_cut_roasted_beef_verbatim: python train.py -s data/dynerf/cut_roasted_beef --port 6019 --expname cut_roasted_beef --configs arguments/dynerf.py --model_path output/cut_roasted_beef
readme_n3v_verbatim.config_table_verbatim: arguments/dynerf.py | Neu3D cut_roasted_beef, flame_steak, sear_steak, cook_spinach; all Technicolor scenes
readme_n3v_verbatim.outputs_verbatim: Outputs: the best-PSNR checkpoint is kept in `<model_path>/point_cloud/best/` (overwritten as it improves; `best/per_frame_metrics.json` records which iteration it came from), alongside the final `iteration_<N>/`. Renders and `debug_metrics.json` go to `--saving_folder`, which defaults to `./results/`.

the number of training repetitions behind the reported table
which of the two SSIM conventions the code computes is the one the paper tabulates
that resume via --start_checkpoint restores only the foreground branch

audited_run_facts._source: static read of the pinned checkout, 2026-09-18; every item carries a file:line in research-wiki/operations/multi4d-n3v-leonardo-reproduction-2026-09-18.md
audited_run_facts.schedule: coarse 2000 (arguments/dynerf.py) + fine 20000 (arguments/__init__.py default, not overridden) = 22000 optimizer steps, batch_size 2
audited_run_facts.held_out_camera: positional index 0 of sorted(glob('cam*.mp4')), i.e. cam00; 300 test frames, 19x300 training views
audited_run_facts.camera_count_guard: scene/neural_3D_dataset_NDC.py asserts len(videos) == poses_bounds.shape[0]; our cut_roasted_beef ships 20 videos (cam04 absent from the N3V release) and a (20,17) poses_bounds.npy, so the positional zip is correct and the assert passes
audited_run_facts.frame_extraction: cv2.VideoCapture, NOT ffmpeg; writes <scene>/camNN/images/%04d.png at 1352x1014 (native 2704x2028 halved, LANCZOS); exactly 300 frames per camera, guarded by a fail-closed count check
audited_run_facts.evaluation_cadence: every 500 FINE iterations only (coarse never evaluates) = 40 evaluations over all 300 test frames
audited_run_facts.best_checkpoint_gate: best/ is only written when psnr beats the running best AND iteration > 16000, so best/ is the peak over the last 8 evaluations, not over all 40
audited_run_facts.metrics_written: results/<expname>/debug_metrics.json is JSONL, one line per evaluation, APPEND mode; fields iteration, psnr, ssim1, ssim2, lpips_alex, lpips_vgg
audited_run_facts.psnr_convention: per-image PSNR over all three channels pooled, then arithmetic mean over the 300 test frames; both render and GT clamped to [0,1] first
audited_run_facts.ssim_conventions: TWO are computed and both reported: ssim1 = GraphDECO 11x11 gaussian-window SSIM (sigma 1.5), ssim2 = skimage.metrics.structural_similarity(win_size=7, gaussian_weights=False, data_range=1.0)
audited_run_facts.lpips_convention: lpips.LPIPS(net) called on [0,1] inputs with normalize NOT passed; the lpips default normalize=False assumes [-1,1]. The reported number is therefore not standard LPIPS. Flagged, not fixed: it may be exactly what the paper reports.
audited_run_facts.seed: setup_seed(6666) hardcoded in train.py; there is no --seed flag, so repetitions vary only by CUDA kernel nondeterminism, not by seed
audited_run_facts.background_init_quirk: scene/dataset_readers.py divides the ply colours by 255 twice, with an in-source comment saying the released numbers depend on it. Deliberate; not to be corrected.
audited_run_facts.foreground_init: 10,000 uniform random points inside the camera-bounded extent, not from the ply
audited_run_facts.resume: --start_checkpoint restores the FOREGROUND branch only; the static/background and transient branches are silently re-initialised. The _gs2_ background checkpoint is written and never read back. Treat resume as unusable; size each run to complete 22000 iterations in one allocation.
audited_run_facts.logging: NO wandb and NO tensorboard anywhere in the repo (repo-wide grep returns zero hits). ADAGS logs to wandb through a sidecar that replays debug_metrics.json, leaving the substrate unmodified.
audited_run_facts.port_flag: --ip and --port are parsed and never consumed; there is no network GUI. The README --port 6019 is inert and cannot clash on a shared node.
audited_run_facts.host_memory: train.py materialises all 19x300 training Cameras into a list, each retaining its decoded uint8 image: about 21.8 GiB of host RAM, plus about 1.15 GiB rebuilt per evaluation. Training images are NOT held on the GPU (batch_size 2 => about 33 MB of GT per step).

leonardo_environment_as_built.venv: $W/envs/multi4d (deliberately separate from envs/adags, which carries numpy 2.3.5 and setuptools 82; Multi4D needs numpy<2 for the mmcv 1.6.0 ABI and setuptools<66 to build mmcv at all)
leonardo_environment_as_built.deviation_from_authors_stack: python 3.11.7 vs the authors' 3.11.6, and CUDA 12.2 vs their 12.1 (torch itself is the cu121 build in both cases). Everything else matches exactly.
leonardo_environment_as_built.libstdcxx_trap: The compiled extensions need GLIBCXX_3.4.29 but the spack module chain puts gcc-runtime-8.5.0 first on the loader path, so both import with an ImportError until LD_PRELOAD points at the gcc-12.2.0 libstdc++. multi4d_env.sh does this, mirroring exp_index/leonardo_env.sh.
leonardo_environment_as_built.torch_cuda_arch_list: 8.0 exported explicitly. The hybrid rasterizer passes no -gencode flags, so torch derives them from the visible device; with no GPU visible the derivation raises IndexError, and a build warmed on a non-A100 would omit sm_80 SASS. Pinning the variable makes the JIT build deterministic across nodes.
leonardo_environment_as_built.torch_home: $W/cache/torch, shared with envs/adags, which already holds alexnet-owt-7be5be79.pth and vgg16-397923af.pth. Compute nodes have no network and LPIPS first fires at fine iteration 500, so these must be cached or the run dies about 2500 steps in.

data_staging.contents: symlinks to the 20 cam*.mp4 and to poses_bounds.npy in the read-only N3V tree, plus a real fused.ply; frame extraction writes camNN/images/ HERE, never into the raw dataset
data_staging.why_symlinks_only: the whole source dir is never linked: transforms_train.json sitting next to poses_bounds.npy flips some loaders onto a Blender branch, the trap the SA4D reproduction hit

fused_ply.provenance: DeGauss Neu3D release, unzipped locally by the user at D:/adags/dynerf_fused/cut_roasted_beef/fused.ply and uploaded unchanged
fused_ply.note: the scene also ships a points3d.ply with a byte-compatible header and 366,366 vertices. It is NOT used: the paper initialises the static branch from the DeGauss dense cloud, and scene/dataset_readers.py reads the filename fused.ply with no fallback.

acceptance_rule_frozen_before_running.band_source: the authors' own validate_repro.sh, dropped from the released tree
acceptance_rule_frozen_before_running.rule: PASS if at least 2 of 3 repetitions land inside the band
acceptance_rule_frozen_before_running.reported_quantity: peak PSNR over the 500-iteration evaluations on cam00. This is selection on the test camera and is reported as such; the final-iteration value is reported alongside it, as is the best/ value (which the code gates to iteration > 16000).
acceptance_rule_frozen_before_running.also_reported: SSIM in both conventions, LPIPS-alex as the repo computes it (no normalize=True), Gaussian count per subset, model size, wall time
acceptance_rule_frozen_before_running.known_limit: the three repetitions share the hardcoded seed 6666, so their spread measures CUDA kernel nondeterminism only and is a LOWER bound on run-to-run variance. It is not a seed spread and must not be cited as one.
